As President, Chris is responsible for the global operations of SCIEX. He unites the company around a shared vision of advancing human wellness through the power of precise science and guides the development and deployment of critical solutions to help customers solve the most impactful analytical challenges in quantitation and characterization. Chris fosters an engaged and inclusive culture where associates thrive and embrace opportunities to drive growth and innovation.

Chris has been a leader in healthcare for more than 20 years, including serving in leadership roles at Fortune 500 companies across the Infusion Device, Pharmaceutical, Biosimilar and In Vitro Diagnostics industries. Prior to joining SCIEX, Chris served as Senior Vice President and General Manager, Core Lab Specialty Products at Beckman Coulter Diagnostics. He joined Beckman Coulter Diagnostics in 2017 and held various leadership roles including VP/GM North America and VP Global Marketing. Before joining Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, Chris lived in the UK for six years with his family and served as the VP/Managing Director for Pfizer’s Hospira EMEA Medication Management Systems business.
Chris holds a Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration with a major in finance from West Virginia University.

As Vice President, Global Manufacturing Operations, Balki provides strategic, operational and organizational leadership for manufacturing, order fulfillment, supply chain, logistics and Environment, Health & Safety (EHS), utilizing the Danaher Business System (DBS).

Balki has more than 25 years of global operations leadership, driving transformative growth through operational scalability, synergy realization and best-in-class performance in service, cost, quality, safety and sustainability. He has experience across several industries including healthcare, heavy-industrial and automotive. Most recently he was Vice President of Global Operations at Werfen. Prior to this he held operations leadership roles at ZOLL, Hologic, Philips Healthcare, Danfoss, Saint-Gobain and NSK Steering Systems America.

Balki holds a Bachelor of Engineering in Mechanical Engineering from University of Madras, (Chennai) India, a Master of Science degree in Industrial and Management Engineering from Montana State University, Bozeman, MT and an MBA in Operational Management from State University of New York in Albany, NY.
Vice President, Quality Assurance & Regulatory Affairs

As Vice President, Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs (QARA), Brenda is responsible for leading the company’s regulatory and quality strategies to ensure our policies, processes, practices and systems are operating in accordance with applicable standards for SCIEX and other regulatory organizations, globally.

Brenda has extensive experience in the medical device and pharmaceutical industries with detailed knowledge of quality systems and implementations; global, federal, and state regulatory requirements; manufacturing; analytical and microbiological testing and strategic development for product realization and launch.
Prior to joining SCIEX, Brenda was Vice President, Quality Management at Becton, Dickinson & Company, where she oversaw their worldwide Surgery Quality organization.
Brenda has an ABD Doctor of Philosophy in Civil Engineering with Nuclear Engineering Emphasis from the University of Utah and a Bachelor of Science in Biology from Valdosta State University.
Vice President, Global R&D and Chief Technology Officer

As Vice President, Global R&D and Chief Technology Officer, Chris is responsible for all aspects of the research and development of LCMS and CE analytical systems, as well as overseeing our Open Innovation partnerships.

Chris has been with SCIEX for more than 25 years in multiple technical and leadership roles. In this time, he has guided the development of innovative technology platforms while helping shape key business decisions, evaluate new opportunities and advance our long-term technology roadmap.
Prior to joining SCIEX, Chris worked as a Research Scientist at the Institute for Marine Biosciences, National Research Council Canada in Halifax.
Chris holds a B.Sc. in Chemistry and a Ph.D. in Translational Energy Spectrometry from the University of Wales, Swansea, UK.

As Vice President & General Counsel, Heather is responsible for providing global leadership of the legal and compliance function which includes anti-bribery and corruption compliance, commercial matters, intellectual property, data privacy and trade compliance.

Heather has nearly 20 years of legal experience and 6 years of finance and accounting experience in both global Fortune 50 companies and international law firms. Heather has been with SCIEX for nearly 10 years, most recently as Assistant General Counsel where she oversaw all commercial legal matters and global data privacy. Before joining SCIEX, Heather worked for several multinational public and private companies including United Technologies Corporation, PAREXEL, Bingham McCutchen LLP and Mintz, Levin, Cohn, Ferris, Glovsky and Popeo, P.C.
Heather holds a BSc in Finance from the University of Connecticut, an MBA in Management from the University of Connecticut and her Juris Doctor (JD) degree from the University of Connecticut.
Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and Global Vice President, Finance & Information Technology (IT)

As CFO and Global Vice President, Finance & IT, Jaison oversees SCIEX’s financial strategy while leading the company’s Information Technology function. He brings more than 20 years of financial leadership experience across global life sciences, manufacturing and consumer products organizations.

Before joining SCIEX, Jaison served as Vice President & CFO at Molecular Devices, where he led a global finance organization responsible for financial strategy, planning, controllership and operational execution. Prior to joining Danaher, he was Vice President & CFO at DESTACO, a Dover Corporation operating company, where he oversaw both finance and IT. He also held progressive finance and leadership roles at Rockwell Automation and Harley‑Davidson.

Jaison is a Certified Public Accountant (CPA) and holds master’s degrees in both Accounting and Business Administration from the McIntyre School of Commerce at the University of Virginia and Harvard Business School. He also earned a Bachelor of Arts in Business Administration from Whittier College.

As Vice President, Product Management, Jose is responsible for the overall ownership of the global SCIEX product portfolio for CE, LC/MS, software ecosystems and accessories including product line management, technology roadmap, new product development, and revenue/margin growth through value creation and commercial support.

Jose has 25 years of experience as a customer in Pharma, CRO and the Biotech industry. In addition to this, he held several senior roles at Waters focusing on marketing and business development for all products and services offered.

Jose joined SCIEX in 2019 as a Senior Director in Accurate Mass Product Management overseeing the entire portfolio of Accurate Mass products. During his tenure he was responsible for the Accurate Mass product line strategy and the execution of that strategy from ideation to end-of-life. In addition to this, he also held a leadership role in Market Development where he was responsible for developing the inbound and outbound marketing strategy for the entire SCIEX product portfolio.

Jose holds a BSc in Chemistry from King’s College London, an MSc in Clinical Biochemistry and Molecular Biology from University of Surrey in the UK and a Ph.D. in Metabolomics from Leiden University in the Netherlands.
As Senior Director, Strategy, Kai is responsible for strategic planning and market research for SCIEX.

Before joining SCIEX, Kai was Strategy Director at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where she led strategy development and deployment for their Genetic Testing Solution business. Additionally, at Thermo Fisher, Kai also participated in a two-year General Management Leadership Development Program followed by roles with increasing responsibilities, where she gained diverse experience in the analytical instrument and diagnostics businesses. Kai has more than 17 years of combined experience in strategy, product management, market development and R&D.

Kai holds a Master of Science in Chemistry and Biochemistry from Texas State University, a Bachelor of Science in Biochemistry from Sichuan University in Chengdu, China, and an MBA from Cornell University in Ithaca, NY.
Senior Vice President, Global Commercial Operations

As Senior Vice President, Global Commercial Operations, Ken leads a direct and distributed team of Sales, Technical and Customer Support and Market Development professionals focused on driving customer success and delivering commercial outcomes.

Ken brings more than 30 years of leadership experience across analytical instruments, software, services and consumables, serving the life sciences, diagnostics and applied chemical markets. Prior to joining SCIEX, he served as Chief Marketing Officer at Nautilus Biotechnology and spent 26 years at Agilent Technologies, where he held senior leadership roles, including Vice President and General Manager of the Mass Spectrometry business. He began his career at HP and Takeda Pharmaceuticals.
Ken holds a Bachelor of Science in Biological Engineering from Cornell University and an MBA in Marketing and Finance from University of California, Berkeley, Haas School of Business.
Kevin Roberts is Vice President, Global Service. He is accountable for service operations globally and the delivery of customer-centric service and support worldwide.

Kevin has been with SCIEX for more than 26 years. He joined the company as a Field Service Engineer and worked his way up to his current leadership position. Over the years, he has played a leading role in implementing a competitive and differentiating global service strategy, an enhanced aftermarket product portfolio, the expansion and increased effectiveness of our aftermarket sales organization and a best-in-class service organization focused on customer success. Prior to joining SCIEX Kevin worked at The Institute for Genomic Research as a laboratory technician in the DNA Sequencing division. He was also a Helicopter Crew Chief in the United States Marine Corps and served as a member of the Presidential Helicopter Squadron (HMX-1).
Kevin holds a Bachelor of Science degree in Biochemistry & Molecular Biology from the University of Maryland, Baltimore County.
Vice President, Human Resources & Internal Communications

As Vice President, Human Resources & Internal Communications, Marcelo is responsible for leading organization and talent strategies to support the growth and advancement of the business and our associates. He is also responsible for creating and maximizing a highly productive, engaged and inclusive culture.

Before joining SCIEX, Marcelo spent two years at Cytiva where he built and executed an HR strategy aligned with the business to sustain growth. Prior to Cytiva, Marcelo worked at Pall Corporation for five years. He started out leading HR in Latin America and then moved to an expanded role where he was responsible for Pall’s Medical and Laboratory business globally.
Prior to joining the Danaher family, Marcelo held HR leadership roles at Gympass and PwC Brazil. For several years he also worked as a consultant at IBM, Promon and KPMG.

Marcelo holds a Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration from Fundação Getulio Vargas, Escola de Administracao de Empresas de Sao Paulo, Brazil, and a Masters of Business Administration from Fundação Dom Cabral.

As Vice President, Danaher Business System (DBS), Pat is responsible for the strategy, design and implementation of DBS to support SCIEX’s global success in technology innovation and commercial execution.

Pat has over 35 years of commercial experience across life sciences, diagnostics and pharmaceuticals. Before joining SCIEX, he was with the Danaher Business System Office (DBSO) as Sr. Director for Growth supporting the Danaher Diagnostics Operating Companies. Before this, he held leadership roles in Global Sales and Marketing at Beckman Coulter Life Sciences. Prior to joining the Danaher family, he held Commercial and Marketing roles with Roche Diagnostics and Sanofi-Aventis Pharmaceuticals.

Pat earned a Bachelor of Science and Business Administration, Marketing from Rockhurst University in Kansas City, MO and a Master of Business Administration from Indiana Wesleyan University in Marion, IN.
Vice President, Global Operational Excellence & AI Deployment

As Vice President, Global Operational Excellence & AI Deployment, Sarah is responsible for the strategic design and execution of a unified operational excellence strategy and AI-enabled performance system that influences how we innovate, operate and grow globally at SCIEX.

Sarah is an experienced leader with deep expertise in end‑to‑end quote‑to‑cash (Q2C) operations and leading large teams and applying technology to modernize commercial operations while enhancing the customer experience at scale.

Before joining SCIEX, Sarah served as Vice President, North America Client Services at Beckman Coulter Diagnostics. In her 18 years with Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, she held a variety of functional and leadership roles across Client Services, Danaher Business System, Finance and IT. Prior to joining Danaher, she ran her own consulting business and before that spent six years in Corporate Finance and Investment Banking roles at Watson Pharmaceuticals, FMV Opinions and Merrill Lynch.
Sarah holds a Bachelor of Science degree in Business Valuation and Corporate Finance from the University of Southern California.
Vice President & General Manager, SCIEX China

Tony Cai joined SCIEX in September 2023 and is responsible for SCIEX China’s P&L. He manages China’s business priorities, oversees operations and develops organization capability to accelerate growth, enhance customer satisfaction and develop talent.

Prior to SCIEX, Tony was General Manager for Beckman Life Sciences China since October 2021. He established a high-performance culture and strengthened team capabilities on commercial and localization. He joined Beckman Life Sciences from Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, where he advanced in leadership over a three-year period as General Manager, Innovation and Growth. Prior to Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, Tony worked at GE Healthcare for 18 years as General Manager, Commercial Operations, and General Manager, Commercial Excellence.
Tony earned his Master’s degree in Business Administration (MBA) from Tongji University.
